documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
INTIMATION FOR RESCHEDULING OF 60TH ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF THE COMPANY ON 26TH AUGUST 2026 (WEDNESDAY) AT 12:00 NOON (IST)

analysis.summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited reported its Q4 FY26 and full year results, achieving a highest-ever annual crude throughput of 11.71 MMT and record production levels for diesel, petrol, LPG, and niche value-added products. The company's annual gross refining margin (GRM) stood at $9.2 per barrel, while the Q4 GRM was $13.75 per barrel, consistently outperforming the Singapore benchmark. Management highlighted a comfortable leverage position with a gross debt-equity ratio of 0.18 and announced a total dividend of INR62 per equity share for the year. Furthermore, the company is progressing with capital expenditure projects including Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS and retail outlets. Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited reported its Q4 FY25 and full year financial and operational results during the earnings conference call.

guidance.claim: Management forecasts that the maintenance capital expenditure will be in the range of Rs. 200 to 250 crores.
guidance.quote: Our maintenance CAPEX remains Rs. 200-250 crore range, and the next year forecast also, we feel the CAPEX will be in that range.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that MS in the southern market has a shortfall where production is less than demand by close to 20 TMT per month.
demand_outlook.quote: MS in southern market, there is a clear shortfall so, the production is less than demand. It is close to about 20 TMT per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has all approvals in place for the Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project, and project execution has started in full swing.
capex_expansion.quote: Some of the important projects that we'll be taking up is Group 2, Group 3 LOBS for which all approvals are in place and the project execution has started in full swing.

capex_expansion.claim: The retail outlet endeavor involving 300 licenses has started, and commissioning will be seen during the 2026-27 financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: Even our retail outlet endeavor for which we had taken 300 licenses has started. And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

capex_expansion.claim: Normal annual maintenance capex is estimated at around INR500 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Besides, every year, you can assume another INR500 crores is our normal capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The revised capital cost for the Cauvery basin refinery project is Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian Oil.
capex_expansion.quote: The revised capital cost is at Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian oil respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL spent Rs. 673 crores as capital expenditure for the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: On the CAPEX front, in the current year, we have spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX for the current year.

capex_expansion.claim: An additional 1.5 MW of floating solar power capacity is upcoming.
The company is developing an FCCU revamp for propylene maximization.
CPCL is working on Group II/III Lube Oil Base Stocks value addition.

margins_costs.claim: The gross refining margin for quarter 4 was $13.75 per barrel compared to the Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for quarter 4 was $13.75 barrel as compared to Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel, which again reiterates that all these efficiencies are constant, continuous and are being sustained over each period.

margins_costs.claim: The core GRM for quarter 4 was $10.3 per barrel.
Forex losses were approximately INR200 crores for the quarter and around INR350 crores for the whole year.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter, it would be for the quarter, it is approximately INR 200 crores,. And for the whole year, it will be around INR350 crores.

margins_costs.claim: The full year GRM for 2024-25 was $4.22 per barrel compared to $8.64 per barrel in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for 2024-25 for a full year basis is $4.22 per barrel as compared to the previous year $8.64 per barrel, but if you compare it to Singapore benchmark which was $3.79 per barrel in the current year, we have performed better.

margins_costs.claim: The inventory gain for the fourth quarter was $0.66 per barrel amounting to Rs. 125 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory gain is not very significant for the quarter. It is only $ 0.66 per barrel. And in absolute rupee terms, it is Rs. 125 crores only.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a Gross Refining Margin of $3.40 per barrel for the first nine months of 2024-25.
Core GRM for the 9M 2024-25 period was $3.75 per barrel.
Net operating expenditure for the 9M 2024-25 period was ₹945 crore.
Interest expenses for the 9M 2024-25 period were ₹165 crore.
Depreciation for the 9M 2024-25 period was ₹457 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 million metric tons, equivalent to 112% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, million metric ton, which equivalents to 112% of installed capacity, breaking records of our previous best of 11.64 MMT achieved in financial year 2023-'24.

orders_capacity.claim: In quarter 4, the company achieved a crude throughput of 2.93 MMT, which is 111% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In quarter 4 of the current financial year, CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 2.93 MMT, which is also 111% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, which is equivalent to 99.5% of its installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, equivalent to 99.5% of our installed capacity and this must be seen with respect to the turnaround that has happened during the year

orders_capacity.claim: Crude throughput for the fourth quarter was 2.974 MMT, representing 113% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: and coming on to Quarter 4, the crude throughput was 2.974, which is 113% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's crude basket consists of 156 types of crude from various regions.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL Crude basket size : 156 nos covering crudes from all regions.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-equity ratio stands at 0.18 at a gross level compared to 0.39 last year.
capital_allocation.quote: Our leverage position now stands at 0.18. Our debt equity stands at 0.18 at a gross level as compared to 0.39 last year.

capital_allocation.claim: On a gross basis, borrowings are INR1,900 crores, and on a net basis, borrowings are INR973 crores with a net debt ratio of 0.09.
capital_allocation.quote: On a gross basis, the borrowings are INR1,900 crores, but on a net basis, it is less than INR1,000 crores, to be precise, INR973 crores. If we consider net borrowing, the debt ratio is only 0.09, which is less than 0.1.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share in addition to an interim dividend of INR8 per share, taking total dividend to INR62 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year, for the first time, CPCL paid an interim dividend, and we are happy to announce that in addition to the interim dividend of INR8 per equity share of INR10 each, the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share, taking the total dividend for the year to INR62 per share, which again is highest ever.

capital_allocation.claim: Capex for the current year was INR856 crores compared to INR673 crores in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the current year, the capex was INR856 crores as compared to INR673 crores in the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-to-equity position as of March 31, 2025, is 0.39 compared to 0.32 in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: When I turn to leverage position, the debt equity position as on March 31, 2025, is 0.39 compared to 0.32 in the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share, representing 50% of the face value.
capital_allocation.quote: With the above, the Board has also recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share that is 50% of face value for the current year and as we all know, this is subject to approval at AGM, which will happen in the due course.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's net worth was ₹7,491 crore as of December 2024.
Total current assets as of December 31, 2024, were ₹10,099 crore.
Current liabilities as of December 31, 2024, stood at ₹5,001 crore.
Cash and bank balances increased to ₹198 crore as of December 31, 2024.

risks_headwinds.claim: Uncertainties due to logistical constraints and volatility of crude oil prices pose challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now with all this, I would like to say the uncertainties due to logistical constraints, volatility of crude oil prices do pose challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that uncertainties stemming from the volatility of crude prices pose a challenge.
risks_headwinds.quote: Finally, the uncertainties due to volatility of crude prices do pose a challenge.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced a CST under-recovery of ₹246 crore during the 9M 2024-25 period.
Exchange variation losses for the nine-month period ending December 2024 were ₹122 crore.
The company made a provision of ₹9 crore for contingent liabilities in the 9M 2024-25 period.

management_commitments.claim: The management stated that the new retail outlets will see a lot of commissioning during the 2026-27 financial year.
management_commitments.quote: And this year, that is '26-'27, we'll see a lot of commissioning out of them.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the ongoing debottlenecking study is expected to be completed in the coming year 2026-27.
management_commitments.quote: But in the coming year, '26-'27, we hope that ongoing study will get completed.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to continuing to operate the refinery efficiently, control operating costs, and maintain capital discipline.
management_commitments.quote: While these are broader factors that may drive volatility, we remain at CPCL focused on things we can control, and that is operating our refinery efficiently in a safe, reliable and environmentally responsible manner and continue to focus on key matrix such as controlling the operating costs as well as maintaining capital discipline

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the normal maintenance capital expenditure for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores.
management_commitments.quote: The normal maintenance CAPEX for the next two years would be around Rs. 250 to Rs. 300 crores, maintenance CAPEX plus small regular CAPEX normally.

management_commitments.claim: An additional 1.5 MW of floating solar power capacity is upcoming.
The company is developing an FCCU revamp for propylene maximization.
CPCL is working on Group II/III Lube Oil Base Stocks value addition.
The company is developing Microcrystalline Wax as a future product.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
